Put BombVault's activity log on any dashboard.

## Added

- **Embeddable activity-log widget.** BombVault now serves a lightweight, iframe-ready widget page showing the live mini activity log (scrollable, newest at the bottom, auto-follow, 10-second refresh) — drop it into Homepage, Organizr, Heimdall or any dashboard that can embed a URL. Set it up under Settings → System → "Dashboard widget": generate the read-only widget token, copy the URL, and check the live preview right there. The token grants access to the activity feed only, the page is a self-contained 11 KB (no app bundle), and the feature is off until you generate a token.

## Fixed

- **/metrics works in production again.** The Prometheus endpoint was being swallowed by the web-app router and answered with the app page instead of metrics; it is now routed correctly (the new /widget route too).
